102382766.description: Iminoboranes comprise a group of organoboron compounds with the formula RB=NR'. They are electronically related to acetylenes, but are usually more reactive due to the polarity.

102407854.name: Phosphatrioxa-adamantane
102407854.description: Phosphatrioxa-adamantane is an organophosphorus compound that is used as a precursor to bulky phosphine ligands.

122213806.name: FDU-NNE1
122213806.description: FDU-NNE1 is an indole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is presumed to be a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor and has been sold online as a designer drug.

125181230.name: 25C-NBF
125181230.description: 25C-NBF is a derivative of the phenethylamine hallucinogen 2C-C, which acts as a highly potent partial agonist for the human 5-HT2A receptor.

129730862.name: Rhodium pentafluoride
129730862.description: Rhodium pentafluoride is an inorganic compound with the formula Rh4F20.

131750190.name: Cetacaine
131750190.description: Cetacaine is a topical anesthetic that contains the active ingredients benzocaine , butamben , and tetracaine hydrochloride .

135681966.name: Lutetium phthalocyanine
135681966.description: Lutetium phthalocyanine is a coordination compound derived from lutetium and two phthalocyanines.

162623790.name: Methionitazene
162623790.description: Methionitazene is a benzimidazole derivative which is an opioid designer drug.

165360174.name: Borate phosphate
165360174.description: Borate phosphates are mixed anion compounds containing separate borate and phosphate anions.

166177198.name: Malouetine
166177198.description: Malouetine is an aminosteroid neuromuscular blocking agent and antinicotinic alkaloid isolated from Malouetia spp.

168310446.name: Etomethazene
168310446.description: Etomethazene (5-methyldesnitroetonitazene, 5-methyl etodesnitazene, Eto) is a benzimidazole derivative with opioid effects which has been sold as a designer drug over the internet since 2022, first...

168324398.name: Insulin glulisine
168324398.description: Insulin glulisine, sold under the brand name Apidra among others, is a rapid-acting modified form of medical insulin used for the treatment of diabetes.

170717998.name: VVD-214
170717998.description: VVD-214 is a drug which acts as an inhibitor of the enzyme WRN helicase. It is being researched for the treatment of microsatellite instability high forms of cancer.

171389998.name: Abenacianine
171389998.description: Abenacianine for injection, also known as VGT-309, is a tumor-targeted fluorescent imaging agent developed by Vergent Bioscience to enhance tumor visualization during cancer surgeries.

171534638.name: 2C-Se-TFM
171534638.description: 2C-Se-TFM is a designer drug from the substituted phenethylamine family, which produces psychedelic-like effects in animals such as a head twitch response.

172332078.name: Fluetonitazene
172332078.description: Fluetonitazene (fluornitrazene, F-etonitazene, 2-fluoroetonitazene) is a benzimidazole derivative which is an opioid designer drug.

177844014.name: Androprostamine
177844014.description: Androprostamines are a pair of chemical compounds isolated from Streptomyces. They are designated androprostamine A and androprostamine B.

900000046.name: 2CT7-2-EtO
900000046.description: 2CT7-2-EtO, also known as 4-propylthio-2-ethoxy-5-methoxyphenethylamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, 2C, and TWEETIO families related to 2C-T-7.

900000174.name: Anhalotine
900000174.description: Anhalotine is a tetrahydroisoquinoline alkaloid found in the cactus Lophophora williamsii .

900000558.name: Dalotuzumab
900000558.description: Dalotuzumab is an anti-IGF1 receptor humanized monoclonal antibody designed for the potential treatment of various cancers.

900000686.name: Efanesoctocog alfa
900000686.description: Efanesoctocog alfa, sold under the brand name Altuviiio, is a medication used for the treatment of hemophilia A . Efanesoctocog alfa was approved for medical use in the United States in February 2023.

900000942.name: Hexahydrocannabivarin
900000942.description: Hexahydrocannabivarin is a semi-synthetic cannabinoid derivative, the hydrogenated derivative of tetrahydrocannabivarin .

900001198.name: MDFEM
900001198.description: MDFEM, also known as 4- -2,5-dimethoxyamphetamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and DOx families.

900001326.name: Narsoplimab
900001326.description: Narsoplimab, sold under the brand name Yartemlea, is a monoclonal antibody used for the treatment of hematopoietic stem cell transplant-associated thrombotic microangiopathy.

900001454.name: PEG-16 macadamia glycerides
900001454.description: PEG-16 macadamia glycerides is the polyethylene glycol derivative of the mono- and diglycerides derived from macadamia nut oil by ethoxylation with an average of ethylene glycol units.

900001582.name: Plutonium(IV) iodate
900001582.description: Plutonium iodate is an inorganic compound with the chemical formula Pu 4, it is a salt which decomposes into plutonium oxide above 540 °C.

900001966.name: Taliglucerase alfa
900001966.description: Taliglucerase alfa, sold under the brand name Elelyso among others, is a biopharmaceutical medication developed by Protalix and Pfizer.

900002222.name: Β-Carbon nitride
900002222.description: β-Carbon nitride , β-C3N4, is a superhard material predicted to be harder than diamond.
